messages:
alex.s: FYI — Nvidia partner requested a quiet launch for H200/B200 marketplace SKUs next month. They want a small partner-preview cohort (5 accounts) and soft press 48h after preview. Need timeline + FW/driver compatibility confirmation. Who can own?

tereza: I can take coord with partner. We need confirmation on driver v2.3.1 + our quant kernels. Is MI300/Gaudi in scope? Partner only asked for NVIDIA, but SI wants Gaudi testbed.

liam_hw: For H200/B200 we need firmware 1.4.2 on B200 nodes and driver 2.3.1. I can run compatibility suite this week. ETA EOD Thu for baselines.

ben_partner_ops: Can we gate preview on a canary pool? I'd like to surface cost SLOs and per-token latency deltas. Also need an embargo window doc for legal. I'll draft.

partner-bot: New ticket created: PRJ-4523 — 'quiet-launch: H200 marketplace preview'. Link: https://tracker/redwood/PRJ-4523

alex.s: Perfect. @liam_hw please post raw numbers to PRJ-4523. @tereza agree we'll keep MI300/Gaudi as stretch goals — keep SI in the loop and tag them in the ticket.

claire: SI integration team here. We can validate Gaudi in parallel but need sample models and docker images. If you give us the image tag, we'll run via our test harness.

liam_hw: Will push a triage image: `redwood/gaudi-test:2026-03-25-preview` by Fri morning. Also listing kernel caveats in ticket.

tereza: Ops ask — can marketing hold public announcement until partner confirms availability? partner wants 'soft announce' only to customers in cohort.

ben_partner_ops: Yes. Drafting a short email template for cohort with Q&A. Also prepping rollback criteria: >10% latency regression or >2% token error rate.

alex.s: Sounds good. Action items: liam (compat baselines + image) by Thu EOD; tereza (partner comms + legal embargo) by Fri; ben (rollback doc + canary pool config) by Fri. I'll sync with product on the pricing tag.

trevor: Pricing note — partner wants to offer a 15% preview discount. Need to record SKU flags so Console shows 'preview' badge.

claire: Got it. We'll queue Gaudi test on Mon once image is out.

liam_hw: Baseline numbers uploaded PRJ-4523 — H200 avg p99 latency +12% over H100 at 2k tokens, cost delta +8%. B200 numbers look good. I'll paste the logs.

ben_partner_ops: Saw numbers. tagging @alex.s — this is within rollback thresholds. Proceeding to schedule canary pool cutover Tue.

alex.s: Great. Marking thread resolved once we hit cohort live. :thumbsup:
